overview: Army of Shadows tells the story of how resistance takes shape in a near-future authoritarian Britain. Under de facto American occupation, a former British army officer builds a covert resistance cell from scratch — navigating betrayal, moral compromise and the tension between patience and action — as young recruits fight to reclaim their country and their futures. The series chronicles the early days of the British Resistance. From first kills and internal betrayals to propaganda campaigns, internment camps, and a climactic political assassination - this is a story about how freedom is taken and how it can be won back. And the question at its heart is timeless: What would you do if your country were occupied?
title: Army of Shadows

overview: Join us every Sunday at 5.30pm on Channel 9 Perth and WA regional and nationally on Saturdays on Channel 9, 9HD and www.9now.com.au as we bring you the best parts of WA and discover the endless experiential possibilities a holiday here offers. There really is no destination like Western Australia.
title: Destination WA

overview: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, NFL GameDay Live updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites.
title: NFL GameDay Live

overview: Quando uma antiga academia de Copacabana enfrenta a extinção como centro de fitness, uma dupla de mãe e filha precisa deixar de lado seus temperamentos opostos e trabalhar juntas para salvar o negócio da família.
title: Body By Beth

overview: The heroes of the program "Leave Your Parents" are adult children who, for various reasons, have not yet acquired their own housing and are forced to share their life with their parents. Some of them returned to their parents' home after a divorce or due to financial constraints, while others simply delayed "flying out" of the nest. Professional realtors, psychologists, designers and even astrologers communicate with the show's heroes and help them find suitable housing and finally start an independent life.
title: Уйти от родителей

overview: When a suave guest with a hidden agenda checks into the Blue Moon Hotel, he forms a bizarre and messy love triangle with the two sisters who work there.
title: Platonik: Mavi Dolunay Otel

overview: On April 15, 2009, several police forces joined forces to conduct the largest raid against a criminal biker group. The result of Operation SharQc was the arrest of 156 Hells supporters, including 111 members in good standing, almost all of the Quebec members. THE EVIDENCE: Operation SharQc is a documentary series that recounts the construction and collapse of the largest evidence ever amassed against criminal bikers in the world. A criminal and legal saga told to us by those who lived it, on both sides of the story: police officers, prosecutors, and the accused.
title: La Preuve : L'opération SharQc

overview: The main characters of the program get into "Take it off immediately!" thanks to letters from relatives or friends who ask to help their loved ones find joy in life again. The goal of the project is to change the heroines not only externally, but also internally. The hosts of the program will have to find out the reasons why women fall into depression, stop paying attention to themselves, and eliminate this by outlining new prospects for the heroines. According to the change, in order for a woman to change and take a new look at herself, she must act decisively and radically. Therefore, no regrets about the past - only a confident look into the future.
title: Снимите это немедленно!

overview: Is your husband complaining about a dry piece of steak or unchewable beef stroganoff? In that case, the "Eat It Now!" program is especially for you!
title: Съешьте это немедленно!

overview: In northern Argentina, the governor's daughter is kidnapped by his trusted man while a crucial lithium exploitation law is being voted on. As the kidnapper's motivations are revealed, a secret plot that began to develop 13 years ago comes to light, challenging the girl's identity. The race-against-time negotiation exposes the true nature of power, the limits of love, and the curses of kinship.
title: Las maldiciones

overview: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.
title: War

overview: Mitchie Torres (Demi Lovato) gets the chance of a lifetime—attending Camp Rock, the prestigous musical camp.
title: Camp Rock

overview: Tilly Ramsey will take Dish It Out viewers on a journey celebrating online trends and family favorite recipes. In each episode, she'll unbox surprise ingredients and tools, revealing recipes sent by celebrity chefs, social media influencers, and loved ones. From secret family recipes to the latest viral food trends, Tilly tackles each dish with her signature flair, creating mouthwatering masterpieces.
title: Dish It Out
Ji Huang Nian, Wo Jian La Ji Dai Quan Jia Chi Rou

overview: Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor tells the story of Dexter Procter, a 10-year-old paediatrician trying to solve – frequently disgusting – medical mysteries, save his job, and find his place in the world.
title: Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor
Ta Cong Ye Se Shen Chu Lai
Chong Fan Jiu Ling Yang Zai fa Jia
Long Xian Sheng, Bie Na Me Jiao Ao

overview: When a modern woman from another world steals her first love, noblewoman Xue Wanning takes control of her fate by marrying the emperor and claiming the throne. With power in her grasp, she's determined to show the so-called champion of equality that in this world, status isn't given—it's enforced.
title: Bu Guo Shi Chuan Yue Nu Er Yi

overview: NFL stars and celeb fans rewatch iconic football games, sharing new context, rare insights, and untold stories.
title: NFL Classics: After Further Review

overview: In The Finder, an Iraq war vet suffers a brain injury that triggers the ability to see connections between seemingly unrelated events, objects or people.
title: The Finder

overview: Four Corners is Australia's premier television current affairs program. It has been part of the national story since August 1961, exposing scandals, triggering inquiries, firing debate, confronting taboos and interpreting fads, trends and sub-cultures. Its consistently high standards of journalism and film-making have earned international recognition and an array of Walkleys, Logies and other national awards.
title: Four Corners
Shen Suan Jiao Qi: Bing Ruo Shi Zi You Dian Tian

overview: After 8 years of silence, Anna finds herself on the doorstep of her older sister Kat in a car with a coffin mounted on the roof. Anna announces she is terminally ill and wants Kat to accompany her on her last trip to Spain. Along the way Anna finally wants to find out why Kat abandoned her after the death of their parents. The two estranged sisters set off on a hilariously dark road trip, doomed to derail. The closer they get to their destination, the harder it becomes to hide the secrets they both harbour.
title: How To Kill Your Sister

overview: Adapted from the novel of the same name, Royal Betrothal follows top scholar Meng Tinghui and young emperor Ying Gua as they uncover a conspiracy amid court turmoil. From rivalry to trust, they join forces to rule together and write a passionate legend of love and power.
title: Royal Betrothal

overview: Real people with real cases enter Providence Municipal Court to stand before Chief Municipal Court Judge Frank Caprio. Caprio hears cases involving traffic, parking, and arraignments for criminal offenses. There's always a bit of fun when the cameras are rolling, but Caprio makes it clear that he is there to do his job.
title: Caught in Providence

overview: The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network -- ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference -- is SEC Now, broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams.
title: SEC Now

overview: From fast casual to fine dining, rising chefs dish out bold flavors for a panel of VIP judges and culinary greats in this one-of-a-kind competition.
title: Next Gen Chef

overview: For Victoria Medvedeva, a successful Moscow TV presenter, other people's feelings are a hollow sound. She's unreflective and easily manipulates people and destinies. Her behavior unexpectedly leads to tragic consequences: both Vika's career and reputation are at risk. On the advice of her boss, Krupsky, Vika decides to temporarily leave Moscow to wait out the conflict. She travels to her hometown of Yalta, at the invitation of her first love, Roman Kuznetsov. But instead of the expected warm welcome and an affair with her ex-boyfriend, Vika faces a series of strange adventures that threaten to ruin all her plans and endeavors and upend her entire life.
title: Вернись ко мне

overview: From the creators of the critically-acclaimed In Search of Darkness trilogy, Aliens Expanded, and First Person Shooter, it's time to enter a whole new world of horror... TerrorBytes! In this new five-part episodic documentary, we explore and celebrate the rich history of horror gaming, taking you behind-the-scenes with the developers, artists and composers of the scariest games of all time.
title: TerrorBytes: The Evolution of Horror Gaming

overview: A declaration of love for a traditional club: to mark its 125th anniversary, this two-part documentary celebrates the legendary club from the Lower Rhine region. Featuring Günter Netzer, Lothar Matthäus and Christoph Kramer.
title: Mythos Borussia - Eine Legende wird 125

overview: Sin City Rehab will document Alison, best known for her Emmy®-nominated series Windy City Rehab, taking the biggest gamble of her career as she expands her successful design business out West. Alison will bet on herself for lofty rewards, diving headfirst into multi-million-dollar client projects and risky flips all while building a team and reputation from the ground up in a flashy new market.
title: Sin City Rehab
Bian Qi Wei Qie, Yi Nu Jong Shi Zhang Gong Zhu

overview: "College GameDay" has been a popular college football pregame show on ESPN since 1987 and has been taking the show to college campuses across the country since 1993. Now the same concept is being used on SEC Nation a flagship show on ESPN-owned SEC Network. Rather than discussing games from all conferences, the show features games involving teams of the titular conference and originates at a location in SEC country. ``SEC Nation'' is hosted by Joe Tessitore, who is joined by radio host Paul Finebaum, former players Greg McElroy and Marcus Spears, and reporter Kaylee Hartung to preview the day's games.
title: SEC Nation
Qu Fu Liu Zi Hou, Huang Shang Yao Fu Ping Zi Gui

overview: Wilderness Explorers: Äijä's Trips returns with new adventures! In the series, well-known Finns and their dogs experience unforgettable adventures with Wilderness Explorers' Aki Huhtanen and Äijä's dog. The guests face the challenges of the wilderness in Käsivarre Lapland and get to test their skills. In the second season, Aki and Äijä will be visited by Jukka Hildén, Pippa Laukka, Emma Kimiläinen, Sari Helin, Shirly Karvinen and Tommi Manninen.
title: Eränkävijät: Äijän retket
Qi Shi Lao Tai Bu Hao Re

overview: A four-part docuseries chronicling the decades of abuse and deceit by Father Marcial Maciel, the infamous leader of the Legionaries of Christ.
title: Marcial Maciel: El Lobo de Dios

overview: At the center of the plot of the series is a service dog working alongside the police. A determined and intelligent dog named Drone helps detectives solve criminal cases and unravel intrigues.
title: Дрон

overview: A four-part adventure film with an intricate plot, unexpected twists and turns, humour and New Year's magic.
title: Бісова пательня

overview: Events take place in the fantastic city of Dark. Vampires, werewolves, and other creatures live in it. Everything lives and breathes here, even the walls of houses. To get into this mysterious city is not at all difficult, but to leave is incredibly difficult. Once a journalist arrives in the city. His task is to cover the events taking place in the Dark. However, everything is complicated by the fact that to distinguish where the truth is, and where only hallucinations, in the city is incredibly difficult. In each issue, he investigates new mystical affairs.
title: Щоденники Темного

overview: "Mr and Mrs Malyshko is a 16-episode ironic detective story about a married couple, Oleksandr and Maria, who are gentle, attentive and loving parents at home. However, as soon as they step outside their apartment, investigator Oleksandr and lawyer Maria immediately turn into irreconcilable rivals. An uncompromising professional confrontation
title: Містер і місіс Малишки

overview: Alina's civilian husband, with whom she has not been together for several years, returns from the war. After being wounded, Serhiy is unrecognizable, his face is disfigured and he has partial memory loss. Alina helps Serhiy recover physically and get back on his feet. And falls in love with him for the second time. But where there should be a happy ending, the trials of fate are just beginning.
title: Ліки від минулого

overview: The Take is an entertainment news and talk show with the latest Hollywood buzz, celebrity interviews, and previews of new films.
title: The Take

overview: ЖК «Сімейки» is a comedy premiere about our lives. The plot is centred on a chat between a house and the families who live there. Every day, they discuss topics that are important to them and resolve issues that every Ukrainian faces: everyday problems, family relationships, children's education, work and daily news. But despite all the heated debates and difficulties of today, the characters resolve situations with humour and positivity. That is why ЖК «Сімейки» is a light story that viewers love so much and which is so lacking in these difficult times. A special feature of the new STB series is that the actors play several characters from different families at once.
title: ЖК «Сімейки»

overview: Two Sisters is a story of love, betrayal, and life's tough challenges. Vera and Alexandra have always been inseparable, but one tragic event turns them into rivals. Love and pain, loyalty and revenge—each chooses her own path, unaware of where it will lead. Difficult trials await them, forever changing their lives.
title: Дві сестри

overview: Lisa Kokhach, a 32-year-old children's dance instructor, finds her life turned upside down when she discovers she must become the guardian of a 10-year-old niece she never knew existed. In search of answers, Lisa arrives at an old yet picturesque house on the shore of Crystal Springs Lake. This house is more than just an inheritance — it's the crossroads of two people's fates united by a common goal. Her new acquaintance, the charismatic and stubborn Mykhailo Stolyar, is also vying for guardianship. Under one roof, they face not only the challenge of becoming a family for the girl but also a dangerous game of emotions that's impossible to ignore.
title: Кришталеві джерела

overview: On the roof of a high-rise building, four Kyivites Lara, Elka, Yulia and Susanna meet the dawn after graduation and decide to live "Here and Now", without waiting for better times. Each of the girls dreams of her happy future, investing in these dreams various things - death, glory, freedom, justice. Over time, they will realize that saving others from death is where they find the most meaning in life, true love trumps fame, and absolute freedom can collide with selfishness.
title: Тут і тепер

overview: It's not just the wedding. Wild weddings are over, but frenzied adventures in Yablunivka continue! Two families – Serediuks and Kryzhanivskis – are engaged in an eternal Ukrainian competition: who has the taller house, the greener grass, and the cleverer children. Day or night, summer or winter – they always have time, inspiration, and imagination to play dirty tricks on their neighbours.
title: Скажені сусіди

overview: The plot of «Nerves of Steel» introduces us to Max, a young and talented manager. His strong, but surprisingly nasty character helps him reach the top of his career but scares away others. Max's grandfather believes that life has no meaning without friends and love, so he finds his own way to influence his grandson. Now Max has a choice: get engaged to the girl his grandfather has chosen for him, or lose his leadership position in the family business and be excluded from the will. The elderly man's chosen one is a plain and not very attractive nurse who works in a nursing home. How will the acquaintance of these very different people end?
title: Сталеві нерви

overview: Anna is a young woman with great prospects. She's finishing her studies and has been offered a place at Stanford University. Ahead lies a bright future and the chance to start a new life in the United States with her beloved, who also happens to be her academic advisor. But everything changes when her mother dies unexpectedly. Anna soon discovers that Stanford will only accept one of them. Her beloved hides this from her and leaves for the U.S. alone, shattering her dreams and leaving her to face her grief alone. Years pass. Anna builds a new life, happily married to her high school friend Illia and raising their son. But tragedy strikes again: their son, taking a friend's car without permission, accidentally hits two pedestrians. To avoid a court case, Anna and Illia decide to visit the victims in the hospital to settle the matter. To her shock, Anna discovers that one of the injured is Oleh—the man who broke her heart years ago. The past resurfaces, threatening to upend their lives once more.
title: Якщо кохаєш — скажи

overview: She is looking for the truth about the past, and he follows her as an invisible shadow, protecting her from the machinations of her enemies.
title: Тілоохоронець

overview: Operative Max Goryachev and police officer Ihor Bezhatchenko are another duet of cop-partners who prove that heroes do not have to look alike in order to successfully investigate cases. However, due to radically different characters and approaches to investigation, the heroes often have quarrels with each other, and because of this, unpleasant incidents at work. Max is used to acting sharply and without hesitation, but independently. After the sudden death of his wife, psychologists forbade him to go out on business alone. Max gets Ihor Bezhatchenko, a balanced provincial family man, as his partner. From the first minutes of acquaintance, the heroes understand that difficult times have begun: Max will have to endure instructions, and Igor - to constantly take risks.
title: Гарячий

overview: Yakuza members Odajima and Kataoka are sent away on a trip after Kataoka, the young wakagashira, screws up. However, this trip hides the true mission: Odajima has been ordered to kill Kataoka.
title: Anata wa Korosu Tabi

overview: One2One is a sports talk show with interviews of sports figures from all walks of life.
title: One2One

overview: An amazing journey of personal growth, in which sincere humor is intertwined with a realistic depiction of the afterlife. This is the transformation of the main character Viktor, a cynical and selfish person who, after the death of his grandmother, finds himself thrown into the spirit world. Through humorous situations, the audience will witness the transformation of a "sloppy scoundrel" into a kind-hearted and selfless person.
title: Примарна спадщина

overview: Dramatic mini-series, the events of which unfold around the burning of the forest in the Chernobyl zone. A series of fires near the nuclear plant threatens to become a terrible disaster for the country and destroy the lives of thousands of people. The head of the emergency department, an experienced and determined firefighter, Andrii Troyan, must catch a dangerous firecracker and prevent a tragedy. But the investigation of the crime becomes a real test for the main character - he will have to survive the loss of a loved one, imprisonment and reveal many secrets, of which he himself is a part.
title: Переслідуючи вогонь

overview: A 16-episode detective story about the impulsive, sometimes tough, but experienced investigator Maxim Kholod, whose daughter disappeared under mysterious circumstances four years ago. Having never solved the case, Kholod despairs, he drowns his grief in a glass every day, and only work saves him from a fatal step. Everything will change when the principled, fair and dedicated linguo-criminalist Alexandra Kosovich joins the investigation, masterfully identifying criminals by pronunciation, handwriting and correspondence style. With only one clue - the last note from his daughter, Kosovich will try to unravel a case in which everyone is trying to hide their secrets.
title: Холод

overview: Ukrainian and now British spy Hryhoriy Didenko returns to his native town of Novohrad-Volynsky after 15 years with a top-secret mission – to obtain a sample of Tabun's newest chemical weapon for the development of an antidote. The obstacles for Grigory will be not only the Nazi regime and deadly gas, but also the distrust of the local residents, whom he is trying to save from the ever-increasing threat.
title: Табун

overview: A new head of the obstetrics and gynecology department arrives – the charming and petite Natalia. However, behind her fragility and defenseless appearance lies a tremendous inner strength.
title: Материнський інстинкт

overview: A fascinating mystical four-part detective story.
title: Злі духи

overview: The classic history of the relationship between parents and children in a modern way, because many problems are as relevant today as in the nineteenth century. According to the plot of the miniseries, after returning home from Harvard, the girl Sonya tries to understand the methods of work of a famous and influential father and discovers many unpleasant things. Raised in love and respect for her parents, she does not immediately dare to go against the interests of her father. However, in the end he comes into open confrontation with him and will fight for justice. Her conflict with Terentiy Puzyr is deepened by the fact that Sonya does not accept the imposed fiancé, who was chosen for her without her consent. Instead, Terentiy Puzyr, a modern dollar multimillionaire, owner of an agricultural holding, considers himself the "master" of the region and human destinies. He manipulates and intimidates people because he seeks to maintain his influence and increase his wealth, and stubbornly continues to be faithful to his old approaches, despite the changing world around him. Bubble does not notice that he is surrounded by the same unscrupulous people as himself, who are ready to betray him at any moment.
title: Хазяїн

overview: A young and not very serious father is forced to take responsibility for the life of his two-year-old son. The baby's mother was tired of maternity leave and decided to test her husband's ability to take seriously anything in life. So now our hero has to grow up.
title: #ЯЖЕБАТЬ

overview: Viktor Viktorovich Vasilenko works as a mechanic at his father's service station, but his real passion is psychology. Thanks to his earnings at the workshop, he was able to enroll in the correspondence department of the Poltava Forestry Institute, where he received a degree in psychology. Vitya dreams of gaining a deeper understanding of himself and helping others find inner harmony. Without hesitation, he begins counseling people right on the job. Every day, residents come to him with their anxieties, complexes, and prejudices, and Vitya tries to help everyone.
title: Вітя

overview: The plot of the series revolves around the NBR, an elite special unit created to hunt down the most dangerous predators in human form. It is headed by a hardened operative Koval (Sergei Strelnikov), whose team works as a single mechanism: ruthlessly, quickly, on the verge of a foul. But where is the fine line beyond which the thirst for justice turns into blind rage? What awaits the team when they are ruled by emotions? Each of them has their own secret - and it's a mystery that keeps you in suspense to the very end. And crime is getting stronger and stronger...
title: Справа НБР

overview: Shido Academy is a secluded all-boys boarding school built on a remote mountainside. Second-year student Hayama Takumi is assigned to share a room with Saki Giichi (nicknamed "Gii") Their unexpected pairing draws jealous and hostile stares from the other students. In truth, Takumi and Gii are secretly in a romantic relationship. While Takumi feels happiness in their bond, deep down he is haunted by the fear that "if I reveal everything about myself, he might come to hate me." Gii, on the other hand, struggles with the pain of being physically close yet unable to truly connect, gradually losing sight of Takumi's true feelings. Amid this fragile balance, a persistent third-year student begins pursuing Takumi. Consumed by jealousy and frustration, Gii finds his emotions pushed to the breaking point. As love, jealousy, and unrequited desires collide within the academy, hidden feelings between multiple students begin to take shape, weaving together a dramatic boys' love school story filled with longing and heartbreak.
title: Takumi-kun Series -Drama-

overview: The last years for our country are tragic. We have lost control of a certain territory, there is a war in the country and people are being killed, but we are not giving up. It's time to listen to the stories of real heroes.
title: Бойові родини

overview: The plot centers on the story of Voron, an experienced detective who has gone through many trials, and Vorobyov, a younger, naive, and romantic hero. The men have completely different characters and methods of work. While investigating a complicated case, they learn about a gangster's safe with 50 million dollars. To get to the money, the rivals are forced to join forces and become a team.
title: Ворон та Воробйов

overview: What to do when you get stuck on a catamaran with a wife and a hated mother-in-law in a middle of a sea? No water, no food, and nobody hurries to save you... Well, then, it's high time to find out the relationships!
title: Рятівники

overview: When modern crimes have their roots in the past, Special Branch investigators use unique techniques, artificial intelligence and digitised archives to prove that justice has no statute of limitations.
title: Таємниці архівів

overview: This is a story about a former prisoner of war, a legendary police major in the past, Skoruk, who unexpectedly returns home two years after his mysterious disappearance. He begins to envision and investigate future crimes that will soon take place. For two years, he was presumed dead, but his miraculous return, strange drawings and the chemistry in his blood suggest one thing: Skoruk cannot be trusted. Who is he? Why did he come back and remember nothing? And the main question: who will win the battle of the demons in Skoruk's head?
title: Митець

overview: Maksym Nikonenko has everything: a favorite job, a lover, money. He is considered lucky and many envy him. But suddenly Nikonenko's life is destroyed - he finds himself in a colony for a murder he did not commit. While in the cell, Max scrolls through every second of his past to find the answer to the main question - who framed him and why. However, fate prepares a new twist for him and a new mystery - the "unknown savior" made a lot of efforts to free Max. Nikonenko is trying to understand who the savior is and most importantly - what is his motive.
title: Хід коня

overview: Taras and Yehor are brothers and doctors in the city polyclinic. Yehor is a macho, and a successful surgeon. His wallet attracts all the girls, but the man wants to find true love. Taras is his exact opposite; he does not have enough money, neither he faces a promotion. Moreover, he should care for his wife and children. Every time the guys make fun of each other and conduct genuine laughter sessions! Throw away your daily routine and enjoy humor from the doctors.
title: Королі палат

overview: The story focuses on Kateryna, a successful architect and head of a design bureau. She is a self-confident woman who has spent her life building a career, family and future. Her life seems stable, though not without internal conflicts. But an unexpected call from the past forces her to travel abroad to visit her sister Irina, whom she hasn't seen in years.
title: Підміна

overview: Paris 1960. The 23-year-old André Merlaux is hired as an intern by the French secret service. He is handsome, intelligent, well raised, and naive.
title: Au service de la France

overview: "Major Skovoroda" is a police comedy with detective elements, centered around the charismatic and unconventional head of the criminal investigation department, Andrii Skovoroda. Assigned to a precinct on the outskirts of Kyiv, he's put in charge of a group of rookie officers who lack field experience. Teaching them how to catch criminals is one thing — but showing them how to deal with people is a whole different challenge, especially for someone like him. Known for his sarcastic humor, philosophical quips, and unpredictable tactics, Skovoroda seems more like a mentor — or even a babysitter — than a tough boss. From generational clashes to unexpected team victories, each episode blends sharp wit, unique investigations, and genuine human stories. This is a series about clashing personalities, team spirit, and breaking the mold of traditional police work.
title: Майор Сковорода

overview: When life crumbles in front of our eyes, dreams of personal happiness collapse, and the accumulated problems lead to a dead end, he comes to the rescue. Dream catcher. A person who is able to solve the most hopeless life situations. A genius specialist whose main tool in his work is our dreams. He will destroy the stereotypical interpretation of dreams and prove that sleep is the key to solving our problems. You just need to read it correctly.
title: Ловець снів

overview: The nationally known coach Regina Lavrentyeva returns with her wards from the junior championship. Two thoughts do not give her peace - at the championship, one of her two daughters (Lana) got a leg injury, and her beloved husband and father, the famous businessman Yurii Lavrentiev, do not meet them yet. However, Regina leaves the airport with her husband's brother, Vlad, who has long been involved in all the finances of Regina's gymnastics school. On the way, they discuss the upcoming celebration of Regina and Yuri's silver wedding and the school's financial situation. Regina calls her stepson Leonid - Yuri's son from her first marriage, with whom she has a very warm relationship (and who now lives and works in America). Later, she tries to call her and Yury's son Mykhailo, who is studying in London, but to no avail. At this time, Yurii is with his young lover Tonya...
title: Колишня

overview: Alena thought her life would be like a fairy tale. But her husband turned out to be a cruel tyrant and a possessive manipulator. Desperate to change her fate, she decides to escape—taking her young son and sick mother with her. Under a new identity, she tries to start over. But her powerful husband has no intention of letting her go…
title: Птаха в клітці

overview: Since ancient times, people with supernatural abilities have been called molfar. At the same time, their main tools are various spells and potions. Not everyone can visit such unusual people: only those who have only pure and good thoughts. "Molfar" tells the viewer a story about a magician. He lives in a remote house near a lake.
title: Мольфар

overview: Fate brings Roman and Daryna together in circumstances they would never have chosen themselves. The forced marriage becomes a test for them, because instead of love, they feel only mutual hatred. Living under the same roof and expecting a child turns into a constant struggle of characters, where every day is a new confrontation. But will they be able to resist the circumstances? And will it turn out that this "game of war" is actually the beginning of great feelings?
title: Зворотний напрямок

overview: The eight-episode film tells the story of a spy who, after being exposed, is forced to accept a failed mission to avoid execution.
title: Виговський

overview: "Service 112" tells the story of a new unit that is being created for rapid joint response of emergency services. A team of specialists from different disciplines - rescuers, police officers and paramedics - now work side by side to respond to calls received by the 112 Service. In a time of war, when there are more threats and fewer experienced people, they overcome not only external circumstances but also their own disputes for the sake of a common goal - saving people.
title: Служба 112

overview: It is a profound yet light-hearted story about how war changes the lives of ordinary Ukrainian families, their relationships, inner world and views on the future. It's about people who, despite all the trials and difficult decisions, find the strength to laugh, love and move on.
title: Обмежено придатні

overview: Nature series which follows the impact of the changing seasons on the ecosystem and diverse wildlife of Loch Lomond and the Trossachs National Park. Beautifully filmed across one tough year, this is a story of birth and death, predators and prey and the struggle for survival in one of Britainʼs wildest locations.
title: A Year in the Wild

overview: When Peppi (36) finds out he wasn't invited to the class reunion, his self-image starts to crack. Fuck! Forgotten? Uninvited? – This must be a mistake! Searching for answers, we follow Peppi to his old hometown and back to the past of his 16-year-old self: Skateboarding with bleached tips through the monsoon of the 2000s. The era of flip phones, lan parties, and Top of the Pops. But alongside the wild, nostalgic memories lurk some dark teenage sins. Maybe there are reasons why Peppi shouldn't have been invited after all. CHABOS is like an old Facebook profile you've scrolled too far down — full of shame.
title: Chabos

overview: In the seaside town of Hel, the death of a prominent local naval captain threatens to expose the web of lies tying his family together.
title: Scheda
